Date: date and time when the crime was reported
Primary Type: primary classification or type of crime committed
Description: detailed description of the specific crime
Location Description: description of the location where the crime occurred
Domestic: whether the crime was classified as domestic violence (0 - no, 1 - yes)
Beat: police beat number where the crime occurred
District: police district number where the crime occurred
Ward: ward number in Chicago where the crime occurred
Community Area: community area number in Chicago where the crime occurred
X Coordinate: x coordinate of the crime location in Chicago's coordinate system
Y Coordinate: y coordinate of the crime location in Chicago's coordinate system
Year: year when the crime was reported
Latitude: latitude coordinate of the crime location
Longitude: longitude coordinate of the crime location
target: arrest status target variable (0 - no arrest, 1 - arrest made)
